messages:
izzy: Heads-up: on 2026-04-20 23:00 UTC we will enforce org-wide OIDC for all CI jobs and deprecate legacy Personal Access Tokens (PATs) for automated workflows. This affects hosted CI, self-hosted runners, and any scripts that call the GitHub API using PATs.

izzy: TL;DR: new enforcement = GitHub will reject PATs with `automation` or `repo` scopes that aren't rotated to our short-lived OIDC-bound tokens. Actions to take: replace long-lived PATs with OIDC-based tokens, migrate service accounts to the KMS-proxy, and update any cron jobs that call the API.

andre: ack. Do we have a compatibility window?

izzy: Yes: 2026-04-20 23:00 UTC start, 2026-04-21 23:59 UTC grace period where we log but do not block. Full enforcement starts 2026-04-22 00:00 UTC. We will auto-block requests that present deprecated tokens after that.

rookie-bot: @channel Dry-run scheduled in the sandbox org on 2026-04-19 21:00 UTC. Monitoring webhook and token-usage metrics will be posted here.

infra: What exactly breaks? PATs used by Workflows (e.g., `secrets.GH_PAT`) and deploy scripts using `Authorization: token <PAT>` will start getting 401/403 after enforcement. SSH keys and Git over HTTPS with username/password are unaffected, but we strongly recommend migrating to OIDC.

devops: Any tool-specific notes? Jenkins/Buildkite/Drone: update the token provider config to use OIDC Oauth flow or our KMS proxy. For legacy tools that cannot support OIDC, create a short-lived machine user with an expiration policy and register it with secops for exception review.

security: Requirements checklist: 1) Replace PATs in repo secrets with `OIDC_ROLE` bindings or KMS references. 2) Update SDK auth flows to call our token-exchange endpoint `https://tokens.redwood.internal/exchange`. 3) Remove any `GITHUB_TOKEN` hacks that mint elevated scopes. We'll scan and open exception tickets for owned repos that can't migrate.

izzy: Helpful scans to find exposures:
```bash
# find repos with GH_PAT in secrets/ci config
rg "GH_PAT|GITHUB_PAT|personal_access_token" -S || true
# find scripts calling GitHub API with token header
rg "Authorization: token" -S || true
# find workflows that set `secrets.PAT` in workflows
rg "secrets\.[A-Z_]*PAT" .github/workflows -S || true
```

andre: Sample fix for a GitHub Actions workflow (replace usage of PAT secret with OIDC):
```yaml
# Before
steps:
  - name: push
    uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - name: publish
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}
    run: |
      curl -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/...

# After (use OIDC - exchange on runner)
steps:
  - name: request token
    id: token
    run: |
      echo "TOKEN=$(curl -s --fail -X POST https://tokens.redwood.internal/exchange -d \"role=ci-runner&aud=github\")" >> $GITHUB_ENV
  - name: publish
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ env.TOKEN }}
    run: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/...
```

rookie-bot: We'll run an automated scanner across all org repos during the dry-run and report top offenders (secrets, header patterns, workflow uses).

infra: Rollback/exception flow?

security: Rollback isn't ideal for token enforcement. We'll allow exception tickets — but any exception must include a sunset plan within 7 days. If enforcement causes >4% build failures across the top-50 pipelines after 00:00 UTC on 2026-04-22, we'll pause enforcement and open an incident. Ops will notify channel and provide mitigation steps.

izzy: Ops runbook snippet for triage if you hit 401s: 1) capture failing request id and timestamp 2) check runner logs for `requested_aud` 3) confirm token exchange logs at `tokens.redwood.internal` 4) if token not minted, run `scripts/debug/oidc-token-check.sh` and escalate to @security.

devops: Will we rotate the OIDC provider certs during the window?

security: Yes, certificates will be rotated at 22:30 UTC on 2026-04-21 to ensure clients refresh. We'll post a notice 1 hour prior. Most runners will handle rotation without restart; if you have pinned certs, update them before the rotation.

andre: Can we get a sample curl to exchange a token during testing?

izzy: Sample exchange (for local dev testing only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://tokens.redwood.internal/exchange \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role":"ci-runner","aud":"github","assertion":"<OIDC_JWT>"}'
```
Response: `{"access_token":"...","expires_in":300}`. Tokens are 5m by default.

rookie-bot: Dry-run executed 2026-04-19 21:00 UTC. Scanner found 112 repos with leftover PAT references; notifications sent to repo owners.

infra: We'll block merging to protected branches for 30m starting at 22:50 UTC on 2026-04-21 to reduce merge-time regressions during cert rotation. Please avoid merges then.

ops-bot: @channel Enforcement live at 00:00:00 UTC 2026-04-22. Monitoring token rejections and build success rate.

ops-bot: 00:15:12 UTC sample: 14 token rejections across 9 repos (0.3% of builds). Owners notified automatically.

security: We sampled rejects and most were stale PATs in archived cron jobs. We opened exception tickets and assisted owners to replace them.

izzy: After 24h, acceptance looks good. We will deprecate the PAT allowance policy on 2026-05-01 and revoke any remaining legacy PATs that are flagged with no migration plan.

andre: Thanks for runbooks and the scanner. Queueing some follow-ups to migrate internal tooling that still relies on older SDKs.

devops: Migrated 12 services to the token-exchange endpoint and updated CI templates.

rookie-bot: Final report: 24h post-enforcement success rate 99.8% across CI runs. Closing dry-run thread and creating summary in PLAT-9321.

izzy: Thanks team. If you see any lingering 403s, post repo + run link here and we'll triage.
